invoiceNumbering.title: Invoice numbering
invoiceNumbering.description: Set the prefix and range for automatically generated invoice numbers. The lock controls the suffix, range, and digit count.

pages.description: Configure system settings, appearance, language, and account preferences.

language.title: Language preference
language.description: Select the language used across the dashboard interface.

tabs.title: Workspace tabs
tabs.description: Control how many pages can remain open in the desktop tab bar.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Set a new password for your signed-in account.

validation.passwordMin: Password must contain at least 6 characters.

errors.requiresRecentLogin: For security, Firebase requires you to sign out and sign in again before changing your password.
errors.weakPassword: Firebase rejected this password because it is too weak.

companyPolicy.title: Company policies
companyPolicy.description: Manage the public terms and policies URL printed on this company’s invoices.
companyPolicy.label: Policy URL
companyPolicy.hint: Use a public HTTPS page. Leave blank to clear the link. This setting applies to the selected company.
companyPolicy.invalid: Enter a valid HTTPS URL without a username or password (maximum 2,048 characters).

invoicePool.title: Offline invoice pool
invoicePool.description: The mobile app shows the available invoice count in red when it reaches this number or lower. If you can generate offline invoice numbers, the portal also sends you a severe warning when the unassigned company pool reaches this number or lower.
invoicePool.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10000.
invoicePool.saveError: The server could not confirm your invoice warning threshold. Refresh and try again.
